title: Ellaz studio moves file
description: The FIGHT half of a character, kept apart from the sprite manifest so a game that does not fight never carries it. A state graph over the manifest's clip names; per-frame hurt boxes (bdy), hit boxes (itr) and a push box in frame pixels of the atlas this file sits beside; transitions on named inputs; an impulse on frame entry. Modelled on Little Fighter 2's frame records (docs/reference/little-fighter-2.md) with names where it had numbers: no 999, no frame ranges, every target a state that must exist.

initial.description: the state a fighter spawns in

inputs.description: the closed vocabulary every `on` key must come from

light.description: the state entered when a hit lands and `fall` has not accumulated past the threshold

heavy.description: the state entered when it has: the knockdown

clip.description: the manifest animation this state plays; frames has exactly as many entries

next.description: the state entered after the last frame; absent means the clip loops (or holds, for a terminal state)

on.description: input -> state, honoured from cancelFrom on

wait.description: ticks this frame holds; absent means the clip's fps decides

bdy.description: hurt boxes: where this frame can be hit. Empty means untargetable (lying down)

itr.description: hit boxes: where this frame hurts others

push.description: the body box two fighters cannot overlap

impulse.description: velocity applied on entering the frame, frame pixels per tick

stun.description: ticks the victim is held in onHit.light

fall.description: how far toward the knockdown one landing pushes
